author: Seung Wook
problem: For a positive integer x, let f(x) be how many positive integers up to x have the same number of digits as x. Read N and print f(1) + f(2) + ... + f(N) modulo 998244353.
bug_description: For single-digit N the program prints N instead of the triangular sum N*(N+1)/2.

comments.accurate: Sums f over 1..N one digit length at a time, adding a triangular number per length, modulo 998244353
comments.wrong_behavior: Sums f over 1..N by digit length; an N below 9 just gives N, otherwise each length adds a triangular number
comments.wrong_location: Digit-length handling verified; check the modular reduction of the triangular product for large N
